The '''Unnipar system''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. At some point between [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The information presented in ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]'' is set between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], which are dated by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], respectively.</ref> [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Monio]] of the<ref name="Planets" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Dentamma Nebula/Legends|Dentamma Nebula]] [[Gambling/Legends|bet]] the ownership of the entire Unnipar system in a high-stakes [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game. The [[Teltior]] [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Ceezva]], who had bluffed her way into the game, managed to win the system from Monio.<ref name="Planets" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Unnipar system was first mentioned in the [[1993]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]'', written by [[John Terra]].<ref name="Planets" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system within grid square H-19.<ref name="EAOC" />
